summary.text: Tracy Richardson is serving her fourth term in the Ohio House of Representatives for District 86, which consists of all of Union County and portions of Marion County. She chairs the House Veterans and Military Development Committee.

paragraphs.text: Richardson is a graduate of West Point who was deployed in Operation Desert Shield/Desert Storm, earning a Bronze Star Medal, and retired from the U.S. Army in October 2024.

Before the House, she served nine years on the Marysville City Council, worked as a corporate human resources professional for a Fortune 500 company, and taught leadership as an ROTC professor at Capital University and Ohio Wesleyan University.
She and her husband, Chris, have three sons and have lived in Marysville since 1998.
